name: External Links
description: Opens links to external sites (and optionally PDFs) in new browser tabs client-side with jQuery, instead of target=_blank.
project_description: This extremely simple module opens all links to external sites in new tabs. It uses jQuery (client-side window.open) instead of target=_blank so the generated markup will still validate. An optional setting also opens links to PDF documents in new tabs, and any link given class="newtab" is opened in a new tab as well. A configuration page at /admin/config/content/external lets you enable/disable the behaviour site-wide, toggle the PDF behaviour, and list Drupal paths (with the * wildcard and the <front> token) on which the behaviour should not run. It is preferred over the extlink module for cases where you only need this one lean feature or where it is important that the dynamically generated markup still validate.
